title: Fema / RBI | RBI Issues Draft NBFC Credit Facility Amendment Restricting Revolving Credit Products
description: Fema / RBIRBI has issued draft NBFC Credit Facilities Amendment Directions, 2026 proposing a bar on revolving credit products except for authorised credit card issuers.The post RBI Issues Draft NBFC Credit Facility Amendment Restricting Revolving Credit Products appeared first on TaxGuru.
